items.title: Charles Calello interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 21, 2025
items.q: after I had my run with Juice Newton and I had a couple of country hits in the ‘80s

ctx.x: They didn’t want to overdub. They were used to doing the whole thing. They didn’t want to wear earphones. They couldn’t play with earphones. It was a lot – it was very, very different. Now here we come along and we’re sort of changing the face of the way that music was working. So I figured that there would come a time when I would not speak the language anymore. So after I had my run with Juice Newton and I had a couple of country hits in the ‘80s, I actually had my last chart record in the ‘90s. And when I left…

because the only business I knew was the record business. Little did I know, my wife was smart enough to know that I wasn’t going to stop writing, so she donated my services to the Pops orchestra and then I started to see the acts come in, they needed arrangements. And I’m saying to myself how come I didn’t know about this?
